name: Stride Launcher
description: The reviewed Stride CLI exposes an explicit `self update` command backed by `dotnet tool update`; its SDK version manager queries the NuGet package store and installs the newest eligible package for a target version line. This snapshot does not establish an every-launch update policy or the end-to-end artifact verification behavior of NuGet/.NET tooling.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; package-source endpoint configuration, NuGet/.NET signature enforcement, and launcher startup behavior were not independently audited.
